requirements.title: IEEE_COPY_SIGN result characteristics follow X
requirements.source: S17.11.3 p5; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF488.
requirements.definition: The IEEE_COPY_SIGN result has the same type, kind, and rank characteristics as X.

pending.IEEE_COPY_SIGN-result-same-characteristi: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE for default real X=-2.5 and Y=1.0, double precision X=-2.5D0 and Y=1.0D0, mixed-kind X=-2.5D0 with default real Y=-1.0, and rank-one default real X/Y arrays. Because p3 requires X and Y to be real and imposes no same-kind restriction, the mixed-kind supported branch asserts the result KIND equals KIND(X), not KIND(Y), and uses IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE under its IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE guard to observe that the sign came from Y. The rank-one branch asserts SHAPE [2].

requirements.title: IEEE_COPY_SIGN result value uses magnitude of X and sign of Y
requirements.source: S17.11.3 p6; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF488.
requirements.definition: The IEEE_COPY_SIGN result has the absolute value of X and the sign of Y, including IEEE special values on processors supporting those values.

pending.IEEE_COPY_SIGN-finite-magnitude-and-sign: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-2.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-1.0), and the mixed-kind pair X=-2.5D0 with Y=-1.0. Supported branch asserts IEEE_COPY_SIGN(-2.5,1.0)==2.5, IEEE_COPY_SIGN(2.5,-1.0)==-2.5, and the mixed-kind result has KIND(X), magnitude 2.5D0, and negative sign observed with IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE under its own datatype guard; mutation swaps the sign source.
pending.IEEE_COPY_SIGN-signed-zero-sign-source: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0), and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.5) for IEEE_COPY_SIGN and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE calls. Supported branch constructs negzero=IEEE_COPY_SIGN(0.0,-1.0) and poszero=IEEE_COPY_SIGN(0.0,1.0), pre-verifies IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(negzero) and .not. IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(poszero), then applies IEEE_COPY_SIGN to X=negzero and X=poszero with Y=-1.0 and Y=1.0. Assert every zero result has the sign of Y via IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE and remains zero by comparison to 0.0; also retain IEEE_COPY_SIGN(2.5,negzero) and IEEE_COPY_SIGN(2.5,1.0) as nonzero sign-source controls.
pending.IEEE_COPY_SIGN-nan-and-infinity-sign-sou: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(0.0), and IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(0.0) for IEEE_VALUE, IEEE_COPY_SIGN, IEEE_IS_NAN, IEEE_CLASS, and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE observer calls. Supported branch creates positive and negative infinities plus a quiet NaN through IEEE_VALUE, applies IEEE_COPY_SIGN with positive and negative sign sources, asserts infinity class and sign through IEEE_CLASS or IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE for infinity results, and asserts the NaN result remains IEEE_QUIET_NAN or IEEE_IS_NAN. For NaN X the plan records no sign assertion: 17.11.14 defines IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE only for normal, subnormal, zero, and infinity classes, and 17.11.2 NaN classes are not signed.
